name: GPUs
blurb: Datacenter and workstation GPUs, by generation, memory, and throughput.

items.name: Instinct MI300 series
items.note: CDNA 3 generation (MI300X, MI325X); the first AMD parts adopted at scale for LLM inference

items.name: Instinct MI350 series
items.note: CDNA 4 accelerators (MI350X/MI355X) with 288GB HBM3E, positioned directly against Blackwell

items.name: Gaudi 3
items.note: Intel's AI accelerator line from the Habana acquisition; Ethernet-native scale-out rather than proprietary interconnect

items.name: B200 (DGX B200)
items.note: Blackwell datacenter GPU; DGX B200 packages eight of them as the standard enterprise training node

items.name: GB200 NVL72
items.note: Rack-scale system pairing 36 Grace CPUs with 72 Blackwell GPUs on a single NVLink domain; the flagship AI training platform of the Blackwell generation

items.name: H200
items.note: Hopper-generation GPU with 141GB HBM3e; the volume inference and training part that preceded Blackwell
